digest.component_or_area: Backend port exception contract in the reconciler transport layer
propositions: The Backend port declares no exception contract, so core reconciler modules catch transport-specific urllib.error.HTTPError, a Cloud leak in vendor-neutral code.
The DC transport raises jira.exceptions.JIRAError, which the existing except urllib.error.HTTPError clauses do not match, so DC errors escape instead of degrading softly.
On DC, remotely-deleted issues are not classified as _DELETED because JIRAError matches neither the 404 nor the transport-error branch, silently breaking deletion detection.
Declare BackendHTTPError in _backend.py subclassing urllib.error.HTTPError so it carries .code and is caught by existing core handlers without core edits.
The DC transport translates JIRAError into BackendHTTPError at the adapter boundary, preserving the HTTP status code.
Cloud's live-validated path must remain unmodified, verified by negative-control tests that a Cloud urllib.error.HTTPError still classifies identically.
